messages:
Alex C: Morning — quick handoff for the early shift. What I did: triaged INC-412 (embed evictions spiking in eu-west1), applied temporary rate limit on embed-ingest queue, rolled back last small autoscaler change. Blockers: still seeing ~5% 500s on embed reads, suspect K/V cache thrash.

Maria L: Thanks Alex. Can you paste the `kubectl` command you used so I can replicate if needed? Also which deploy rolled back?

Alex C: Sure: `kubectl -n inference scale deployment/kv-cache --replicas=3` — I also pinned `embed-service:v2.14.1` to avoid the new autoscale hook. Rollback done via `argocd app rollback embed-service 2`.

oncall-bot: Alert: CPU on inference-node-eu-12 at 92% — autoscaling suppressed for eu-west1 (policy: temporary-manual).

Jordan P: I'll take embeds read 500s. My plan: enable verbose KV cache metrics, and run a small local replay of the hot prefix set to reproduce. ETA ~30m.

Kat S: I'm on infra duty — looking at eviction logs now. If it's cache size, we should bump `kv_cache.max_entries` from 200k -> 300k for the short term. Will submit a patch for review.

Alex C: Sounds good. Action items: Jordan to reproduce + confirm patch, Kat to PR config bump (small change), Maria to monitor throttles and index rate limits. If 500s persist after config bump, fallback to `embed-service:v2.13.8` full rollback.

Maria L: Monitoring: added a dashboard panel for kv eviction rate and embed read 5xx counts. Alert set: if 5xx rate > 1% for 10m, escalate to @oncall.

Jordan P: Reproduced locally — eviction spikes when prefix churn > ~15k/s. Trying bumping cache retention and re-running. Will update in thread.

Alex C: FYI deploy scheduled at 03:45 UTC (non-prod) — please hold any config merges until we confirm KV behavior.

Kat S: PR opened: `infra/kv-cache-bump` — added feature flag gated by env `KV_CACHE_EMERGENCY_BUMP=true`. Link: https://git.redwood/infra/pull/912.

Maria L: I'll apply the flag to eu-west1 canary once PR merges. Oncall runbook updated with the rollback commands and links.

Jordan P: After bumping retention locally, eviction drops ~80% and 5xxs stop in replay. Next: validate on a small canary. Assigning myself to coordinate canary.

Alex C: Great. Next steps: Jordan -> canary test (owner), Kat -> watch PR and prepare rollback notes, Maria -> monitor live metrics and alert. If green by +45m, we'll let the patch roll. If not, perform full service rollback.

oncall-bot: Note: New incident created INC-418 for embed 5xx surge, severity P2. Assigned to Jordan P.

Alex C: Closing notes for handoff: no customer-facing degradation expected currently, but keep oncall channel open. I'll be reachable for 30m then offline. Good luck. :thumbsup:
